title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Resources read like aapt, catalogs kept apart
summary: A commented-out <string> was a real resource and a name in second position was invisible; a library's or an SDK's R.string was a red error; a second version catalog had every alias reported dead and a rich version made its catalog unreadable. All fixed, with module-aware resolution of R.string and decoded escapes in the hover.

highlights.title: strings.xml read like aapt
highlights.description: A commented-out `<string>` no longer exists for hover, Go to Definition or the diagnostics; `<string translatable="false" name="x">`, `<string name="x"/>` and `<item type="string">` now do. `R.string.x` resolves to the module of the file naming it, and the hover decodes `\'`, `\n` and numeric entities.

highlights.title: No red error on code that compiles
highlights.description: `default_web_client_id` and the other SDK-owned keys, a `resValue("string", …)` from a build script and a qualified `com.other.lib.R.string.x` were "Cannot resolve string resource" errors.

highlights.title: Version catalogs kept apart
highlights.description: Two `create(...) { from(files(...)) }` blocks mapped both files to `libs`, so the second catalog was all dead aliases. `strictly = "[4.0, 5.0["` no longer swallows the file, a multi-line entry carries its diagnostic on the alias line, and `includeBuild("gradle/plugins")` counts as convention plugins.

sections.heading: Resources
bullets: Commented-out resources are not indexed; `name` in any position, self-closing strings and `<item type="string">` are.
SDK-owned keys, `resValue` strings and library-qualified `R` are not errors.
Hover and Go to Definition prefer the module of the referencing file; Android escapes are decoded.
`app/` scores as the application in the shadowing hover.

sections.heading: Gradle
bullets: Each `create(...) { from(files(...)) }` block maps its own catalog.
Rich versions with brackets in strings parse; multi-line entries report on the alias line.
Convention plugins from any `includeBuild` are read; the Run task lens stays on `build.gradle.kts`.
"Download library sources" reads commented versions, multi-line entries and `_` aliases, and skips `$var` coordinates.
A `postSticky` read back with `getStickyEvent(X::class.java)` is heard.
